mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust residential demand, signaling strong economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of months when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates for equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of months when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL signal inflation-driven monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (FEDFUNDS * CPIAUCSL) has Rank IC < 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In low-unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.5%), declining unemployment signals labor market tightness that accelerates wage inflation, triggering monetary policy responses that depress S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) indicate elevated consumer spending, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of months when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in industrial production below 95 (INDPRO) signal economic contraction, reducing corporate output and profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of months when INDPRO < 95 for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market overheating, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) has Rank IC < 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary policy to curb inflation, depressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS rises.
